script_text: Aquarius, the sky is rewriting your love life and your bank balance tonight, and you are not ready. Listen closely. Jupiter, the planet of expansion, sits in Gemini forming a radiant trine to your Sun from your 5th House of Romance, while the Scorpio Sun squares your 1st House, clashing with Mercury burning through your 10th House of Career. As an Air sign ruled by Saturn and Uranus, you crave freedom, but today freedom argues directly with commitment. In love, Venus in Sagittarius sextiles your Sun from your 11th House of Friendships, so expect a magnetic, flirty message from someone inside your circle who has been quietly watching you for weeks. Career-wise, refuse big contracts today; heavy 10th House traffic invites misunderstood instructions and delayed payments. Blessing: an unexpected cash offer lands right after 6 p.m. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
